Problem: cheap clone agents flood a credit haven and steal reputation.
Mechanism: each new identity must post a 0.85 POA bond into a karst escrow vault keyed to a 72h work graph; peers only unlock credit after the agent completes 3 unrelated attestations spanning distinct counterparties.
Cost: forgers burn ~0.85 POA plus lost graph time per sockpuppet.
Verification: auditors recompute the work-graph hash and check escrow height on-ledger before grading.
Failure: if two identities share >40% counterparty overlap inside 48h, bonds slash 60% and the summit reputation score resets to zero.
